releases.notes:
**Client-side chain mining for Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric).** Hold a hotkey, point at a block: the whole connected group gets a white preview outline and a block counter next to the crosshair. Mine one of them and the rest are mined one by one through the **real vanilla mining path** — real animation, drops, tool durability and server validation. Reachable targets are green, unreachable ones red, refreshed live while you move.

Same feature set as the 1.21.11 build, ported to Minecraft 26.2.

**Requires** Minecraft 26.2, Fabric Loader 0.20.0+, Fabric API 0.161.0+26.2, [malilib (sakura-ryoko, 26.2)](https://github.com/sakura-ryoko/malilib) 0.29.6+ and **Java 25**. Client side only; ModMenu optional.

### Notes for the 26.2 build

- Minecraft 26.2 ships unobfuscated, so this build compiles against the Mojang names directly — no mappings, no remapping step. Loom runs in its non-obfuscated mode (`net.fabricmc.fabric-loom` 1.19.1).
- The chain outlines now go through the new gizmo pipeline (`Gizmos` / `GizmoStyle`, collected from a `LevelRenderer` mixin at `finalizeGizmoCollection`) instead of the old `WorldRenderEvents` / `GizmoDrawing` path.
- The config screen, HUD and hotkeys are unchanged; the mod now follows the vanilla language setting, so a Chinese game gets Chinese labels (en_us / zh_cn are both bundled).

### 0.1.1 变更（Minecraft 26.2 版）

- 功能与 1.21.11 版一致，本版为 **Minecraft 26.2 移植**。
- 26.2 官方已不再混淆，本版直接使用 Mojang 真名编译，构建走 Loom 的无重映射模式（`net.fabricmc.fabric-loom` 1.19.1）。
- 框线渲染改走 26.2 新的 gizmo 管线（`Gizmos` / `GizmoStyle`，在 `LevelRenderer` 的 `finalizeGizmoCollection` 处收集），替代旧的 `WorldRenderEvents` / `GizmoDrawing`。
- 配置界面、HUD 与快捷键行为不变；模组现在跟随原版语言设置，中文游戏即显示中文（内置 en_us / zh_cn）。
- 安装：需要 Minecraft 26.2、Fabric Loader 0.20.0+、Fabric API 0.161.0+26.2、[malilib（sakura-ryoko，26.2）](https://github.com/sakura-ryoko/malilib) 0.29.6+ 与 **Java 25**。

> [!CAUTION]
> Use at your own risk — see the warning in the README. Most servers consider automated mining cheating, and using it can get you kicked, rolled back or banned.

releases.notes:
**Client-side chain mining for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric).** Hold a hotkey, point at a block: the whole connected group gets a white preview outline and a block counter next to the crosshair. Mine one of them and the rest are mined one by one through the **real vanilla mining path** — real animation, drops, tool durability and server validation. Reachable targets are green, unreachable ones red, refreshed live while you move.

**Requires** Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+, Fabric API and [malilib (sakura-ryoko, `LTS/1.21.11`)](https://github.com/sakura-ryoko/malilib) 0.27.20+. Client side only; ModMenu optional.

### Changes in 0.1.1

- **Fixed** — with a tool fast enough to break blocks instantly the entire group used to vanish in a single tick even with a non-zero mining interval. The interval is now enforced for every block: at most one block per tick unless the interval is 0.
- **Default mining interval is now 5 ticks** (was 2).


### 0.1.1 变更

- **修复** —— 工具快到能瞬间破坏方块时，即使挖掘间隔不为 0，整组方块也会在同一刻消失。现在间隔对每一块都严格生效：除非间隔为 0，否则每刻最多破坏一块。
- **挖掘间隔默认改为 5 刻**（曾经是 2）。


> [!CAUTION]
> Use at your own risk — see the warning in the README. Most servers consider automated mining cheating, and using it can get you kicked, rolled back or banned.

releases.notes:
First release: **Client-Side Vein Miner 0.1** for Minecraft **1.21.11** (Fabric, client-side only).

> [!CAUTION]
> ## ⚠️ Use at your own risk — you are responsible for any server ban

### Install
1. Minecraft **1.21.11** with **Fabric Loader >= 0.19.5**
2. **Fabric API** 0.141.6+1.21.11
3. **malilib** 0.27.20+ (sakura-ryoko's LTS/1.21.11 branch)
4. Put `client_vein_miner-0.1.jar` and the two dependencies above into `.minecraft/mods/`
5. ModMenu is optional

### What it does
- Hold the activate hotkey (default: grave accent) while pointing at a block: the whole connected group of same-type blocks is outlined in see-through white, and the HUD shows `Chainable: N blocks` next to the crosshair.
- Mine any one of them: the rest are mined one by one through the **real vanilla mining path** - real break animation, drops, tool durability, enchantments and server checks.
- Reachable targets are green, out of reach ones red, refreshed in real time as you move.
- `X` force-stops the chain; the activate hotkey + `C` opens the config GUI.

### Defaults worth knowing
- Flood fill over the 3x3x3 neighbourhood (26 neighbours, diagonals included).
- Max Blocks 128 (1-1024) | Mining Interval 2 ticks | Mining Progress Threshold 100 = vanilla timing (70 is the fastest the server accepts).
- Ignore Tile Entities on | Match Exact State off | Auto Stop Seconds 5 | Require Line of Sight off.
- Chaining needs the main toggle and the Chain Mining toggle on; turning either off mid-chain stops it immediately.

### Notes
- Client-side only - nothing to install on the server.
- Requires **Java 21**.
- `client_vein_miner-0.1-sources.jar` is attached for reference.
